note: Track steps-to-leaps (voice-intervals), step 17: mix of 4ths and 5ths, both leaps from one Do up and down over a drone in three keys, a 5ths-stage tune that fills its 5ths with steps and drops under Do (in two keys), then one that starts under Do and holds four 5ths and one 4th. missing: 5ths-stage tunes rated Hard (the stage holds only Medium and Expert tunes, so an intermediate singer gets two Expert ones, both with eighths or a dotted note), and a tune in that stage with as many 4ths as 5ths.

exercise.title: 4ths and 5ths, side by side
exercise.why: From Do a 4th lands on Fa and a 5th on Sol, one step apart, so singing the two leaps side by side and filling them with steps teaches your ear which one a tune asks for.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows on the staff. From the low {{1}}, leap up to {{4}} and back, then up to {{5}} and back, on "ah". Then go under {{1}}: leap down to the {{5}} under it, a 4th, and down to the {{4}} under it, a 5th.
Once each leap lands without a slide, sing them in another key. Use the Key selector below to change the key, then press Start exercise to start the drone there.
When you change the key, the drone moves and {{4}} is still one step under {{5}}.

Press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. It leaps a 5th from Do up to Sol and steps down, then does the same from Re up to La. At the end it drops a 5th, from Re to the Sol under Do, and comes home through the Ti under Do. Listen once, then sing along on "la".
Once the drop under Do lands without a slide, try the tune in another key. Use the Key selector below to change the key, then press Play to hear the tune there.
When you change the key, Do moves and the three leaps are still 5ths.

This tune starts on the Sol under Do. Its leaps are all 5ths but one: near the end it leaps a 4th, from Re up to Sol. Tap its first note below to hear it. Then press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. Listen once, then sing along on "la".
If the 4th lands too high, sing Re, Fa, Sol slowly, then put the leap back in the tune.
